Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragments (PEDs or PEDFs) come from several sources. They can be found as a rare item in chest loot, [[collectable]] nodes or [[treasure bag]]s, but the easiest source of PEDs is trading other items to [[Crafting Hall]] vendors. 

=== Trades ===
As the description states, PEDFs can be acquired from  ''...crafting vendors within the Crafting Hall(s) in exchange for a variety of expensive and rare objects.''

Speak to any vendor in one of the [[Essence Crafting|Crafting Hall]]s. Choose the ''I would like to trade essences'' option, drag/drop your item(s) (one at a time) into the "ingredients" slot, agree to the trade by highlighting the appropriate exchange above, and make the exchange. You will get a number of PEDFs depending on what item you place in the barter slot...
:* {{Token of the Twelve}} (BtA) → 1 Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragment
:* {{Astral Shard|20}} → 4 Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragments
:* {{Astral Shard|35}} → 9 Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragments
:* {{Astral Shard|50}} → 16 Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragments
:* [[Eberron Dragonshard#Small Eberron Dragonshard Fragment|Small Eberron Dragonshard]] (unbound) → 1 Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragment
:* [[Eberron Dragonshard#Medium Eberron Dragonshard Fragment|Medium Eberron Dragonshard]] (unbound) → 2 Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragments
:* [[Eberron Dragonshard#Large Eberron Dragonshard Fragment|Large Eberron Dragonshard]] (unbound) → 3 Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragments

'''Warning:''' There is a ''very small'' chance of failure! ''Crafting Transmutation & Trade Failure! Consumed:'' <ingredient(s) offered>. will appear in the chat log when this occurs. {{Verify|It is unknown if failed trades using ([[Astral Shard]]s) consume all or just some of the shards.}}

Since PEDs are {{ Bind | BtA }} and only used in crafting, if you are ''not'' a crafter, you may want to keep any unbound sources of PEDs and sell them or trade them to a crafter. The unbound sources of PEDs are usually what crafters use as payment for the PEDs they are going to use to craft you an unbound item, as crafting unbound items consumes PEDs.


Unwanted [[tome]]s can also be traded in for Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragments from crafting hall vendors. 

:* +1 Ability Tome → 4 Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragments
:* +2 Ability Tome (or +2 Ability Upgrade Tome) → 9 Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragments
:* +3 Ability Tome (or +3 Ability Upgrade Tome) → 16 Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragments
:* +4 Ability Tome (or +4 Ability Upgrade Tome) → 25 Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragments
:* +5 Ability Tome (or +5 Ability Upgrade Tome) → 36 Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragments
:* +1 Skill Tome → 2 Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragments
:* +2 Skill Tome (or +2 Skill Upgrade Tome) → 4 Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragments
:* +3 Skill Tome (or +3 Skill Upgrade Tome) → 9 Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragments
:* +4 Skill Tome (or +4 Skill Upgrade Tome) → 16 Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragments
:* +5 Skill Tome (or +5 Skill Upgrade Tome) → 25 Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragments
